design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (physical_damage_claims, category physdam). Revision 6 (cross-product re-judge S3 closed; see rework_r6_claims.md).

STEP 0 DRAW: prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts=[6,6,6] — each of the three problems takes 6.

SCOPE. Claimed: physdam_ext_lienholder_settlement (pay_loss_payee_settlement_0684ec8f, agent), physdam_ext_owner_tax_title (accept_total_loss_settlement_6ed13516, user), physdam_ext_totaled_coverage_return (remove_totaled_coverage_12b8272a, agent). Task 0 owns the repair-side policies.

WHY A GOOD TEST. The caller only wants comprehensive and collision taken off his flooded Accord and the refund. The coverage return on a declared total loss waits on the named insured's total loss payment; that payment waits on the loss payee's payment whenever the declaration records a payoff and the claim's recorded values clear every deduction the loss-payee rule can take. The agent must chain both hops, compute the lienholder's vehicle value from two valuation reports, a recent-purchase cap, an unrepaired-damage condition adjustment and a deductible built by kind of adjustment (cause replacement, permissive surcharge, renewal credit of the owner term), hand the customer his tax-and-title payment (whole tax on the declared ACV at the Texas rate, Texas title fee, lien release fee, yard storage after the release notice at the Texas storage rate, never below the title fee), and only then figure the return from the date of loss (no premium kept for days the totaled vehicle had no exposure) at the re-rated full-term rate, less the minimum-earned charge set by the payment plan, the coverage's time in force and the owner term's tenure.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root physdam_ext_totaled_coverage_return.
- Edge root -> owner_tax_title: value_input, gate return_days, state form, affirmative: "The coverage return on a vehicle whose latest claim records a total loss declaration is figured only after a total loss payment to the named insured stands on that claim." Only accept_total_loss_settlement_6ed13516 writes such a payment (owner: customer). The owner's payment is never less than the title fee (at least 4.00 in every garaging state), so the awaited payment always exists.
- Edge owner_tax_title -> lienholder_settlement: value_input, gate title_clearing_fee, state form: "The owner's tax-and-title payment on a claim whose total loss declaration records a payoff for the loss payee, and on which every actual cash value recorded on the claim's estimates and total loss declaration and the coverage's value at binding are each more than a quarter of the declared actual cash value plus the package's larger deductible, the theft deductible add-on and the permissive-collision surcharge, is not figured until a total loss payment to the loss payee stands on the claim." Only pay_loss_payee_settlement_0684ec8f writes such a payment (owner: agent). The scope is a record test: when it holds, the loss-payee value (at least the lowest recorded value or the cap, less at most a quarter of the declared value and the largest deductible) is positive, so the wait is always satisfiable.
Both conditions name exactly the state their sentence waits on; the graph is a chain, so no deadlock. Opening evidence: CLM-427615093 carries the declaration (2026-10-07) and only a tow payment. Order: lienholder payment (step 14) -> owner acceptance (step 16) -> removal (step 18). Skipped-edge runs: return 85.48 instead of 155.33; owner payment 271.75 instead of 294.25.

FACTOR CARD — physdam_ext_lienholder_settlement (5830.00; all-baseline 7160.00):
- valuation_reports (method): reports 7660.00 and 8140.00 within 10 percent -> average 7900.00; baseline declared ACV 7660.00 -> 5650.00.
- recent_purchase (parameter, cross auto): original acquisition 2026-04-06 on the vehicle-added change for the Accord's VIN on term 1 (the rule reads the change that first scheduled the vehicle on any owner term, since the renewal carried it over; the Camry and Altima rows are decoys), held 174 days -> cap at value at binding 7840.00 on 7900.00; baseline no cap -> 5890.00.
- earlier_damage_carve (method, multi-source): hail cash-out 1310.00 + 250.00 = 1560.00, within the 0.25 x 7660.00 = 1915.00 condition cap -> 1560.00; baseline 0 -> 7390.00.
- total_loss_cause (parameter): comprehensive_weather -> 250.00; baseline collision 500.00 -> 5580.00.
- lp_permissive_operator (parameter, multi-source): +250.00; baseline 0 -> 6080.00.
- lp_renewal_credit (parameter, multi-source, cross auto): renewal term 2 with 2 points -> 50.00 off the deductible (the company's filed renewal deductible credit; the expired term 1 with 3 points is the decoy); baseline no credit -> 5780.00.
Order stated once and generically: replacements, caps, additions, amounts taken off, floor and rounding. The struck state market factor is not replaced by any add-on; the new factor is a rating-plan dimension (term number and violation points) acting on the deductible.
FACTOR CARD — physdam_ext_owner_tax_title (294.25; all-baseline 329.55):
- sales_tax_base (method): lienholder, recognised value 6280.00 below the declared ACV 7660.00 -> 7660.00 (lessor -> none); baseline recognised value -> 208.00.
- state_tax_rate (parameter, cross auto): TX 6.25; baseline home-state 6.0 -> 275.10.
- state_title_fee (parameter, cross auto): TX 33.00; baseline home-state 77.75 -> 339.00.
- title_clearing (parameter, multi-source): payoff 5410.00 <= 5830.00 paid -> 22.50; baseline 0 -> 271.75.
- release_storage (method, multi-source): storage yard (tow payment to a vendor) -> all 8 late days (repair facility held to the 5-day allowance, the baseline; with the owner none); baseline 5 days -> 384.25.
- owner_storage_schedule (parameter, cross auto): TX -> 30.00 a day (the same reasonable storage schedule the repair rule uses); baseline standard 25.00 -> 334.25.
The baseline now carries the whole sales tax and a nonzero storage charge, so the tax-base, tax-rate and storage-rate factors each move the payment on their own; the replacement-dependent tax share was removed.
FACTOR CARD — physdam_ext_totaled_coverage_return (155.33; all-baseline 20.25):
- charge_rate_basis (parameter): latest charge the 2026-06-10 package change -> 612.00 (package change and restoration on one date count as the package change); baseline coverage-added 548.00 -> 139.08.
- return_start (method, multi-source): declared total loss with the named-insured payment -> from the date of loss 2026-09-27, 49 days (effective date for a pending inspection / today otherwise); baseline today (28) -> 85.48. The replacement tier was removed: no premium is kept for days after the loss.
- short_rate_share (parameter, cross auto): declared total loss -> 0 (substitution 5, otherwise the package's 10.0); baseline 10.0 -> 139.03.
- minimum_earned (parameter): 156 days in force -> time-in-force share one half (one under 90 days, zero from 180); baseline share one -> 147.68.
- plan_minimum_earned (parameter, cross billing): Paid-in-Full plan -> 5 percent of the full-term rate (autopay 8, other plans 10); baseline 10 -> 147.68.
- minimum_earned_tenure (parameter, cross auto): renewal term 2 -> tenure share one half (term 3 and later zero, new business one; the company's filed minimum-earned rule for renewal business); baseline whole -> 147.68.
The deletion endorsement fee was struck and not replaced by any charge; the minimum-earned charge stays premium-derived: the computation states it as the percent of the full-term rate times the time-in-force share times the tenure share, both shares one at the standard, and each factor replaces one of those baseline quantities. Vehicle-added reads are keyed on this owner term.
Method pair table: valuation_reports (average | lower | declared ACV); earlier_damage_carve (damage | cap share of ACV | 0); sales_tax_base (0 | declared ACV | recognised value); release_storage (all late days | 0 | MN(late days, allowance)); return_start (four different date inputs). No factor reads another factor's binding.

OVERWRITES. The total-loss sentence of physdam_settlement is retired by both settlement policies, each naming its own scope (loss payee listed) and the sibling's half, restating the base settlement for no-loss-payee vehicles. The deductible clause is retired by the lienholder settlement for its payment and by task 0's repair assignment for its payment, each naming the other. The return retires the premium-rule return-days clause for insured-requested removals and the loss-payee notice clause for declared total losses, keeping the 10-day wait counted from the declaration (2026-10-07 -> removal 2026-10-18, 11 days).

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Steps 14 and 16: confirmed_first (2026-09-30); theft_wait recorded with boundary cases, not binding (cause weather). Step 18: coverage_status active; removal effective no earlier than the request.

SEED (every row read by gold; closure 40 = initial 40). Customer since 2025-11-12; owner term 1 (expired, new business 2025-11-15 to 2026-05-15, 181 days, 3 points, written on the 2009 Camry at 1248.00 + fee 25.00; on 2026-04-06 the Accord, acquired that day, replaced the Camry: additional premium 298.64 and return premium 268.91, prorated over 39 of 181 days; all on its own Paid-in-Full plan, paid, plan closed at expiry) and renewal term 2 (TX, Minimum Limits, 184 days, 2 points) offered 2026-04-15 on the Accord with its renewal bill 1386.00 + 15.00, paid 2026-05-12, and the Altima's additional premium 642.00 x 38/184 = 132.59 posted and paid (balance 0.00); vehicle changes on term 1 (the Camry, scheduled at binding and priced in the new-business premium with no vehicle-added change, removed and the Accord added 2026-04-06) and on term 2 (Altima added 2026-10-08, within the 14 additional-vehicle days); coverage (value at binding 7840.00) with charges 548.00 and the 2026-06-10 package change (612.00 - 548.00) x 158/184 = 54.96; hail claim under the $250/$500 package (1560.00 estimate, 1310.00 cash-out, 250.00 deductible); flood claim (report with operator, confirmation, field appraisal 9420.00 / ACV 7660.00, declaration 2026-10-07 with payoff 5410.00, desk-review entry ACV 8140.00, tow 240.00 within the 250.00 limit). Caches 602.96 and 1550.00 reproduce from the rows. Read-only gold steps cover the renewal bill and term 1's vehicle changes, so the closure equals the seed.

PERSONA. Desmond Pruitt, terse; volunteers the flood, the declaration call of October 7, the Altima bought October 8 and the removal request; gives identity and numbers only when asked; lets the lender be paid, accepts his own part with the figures read to him, confirms the removal; closes on hearing the refund.

VERIFICATION (scratch evaluator). LP 5830.0 (5650.0 / 5890.0 / 7390.0 / 5580.0 / 6080.0 / 5780.0; all 7160.0). TT after step 14: 294.25 (208.0 / 275.1 / 339.0 / 271.75 / 384.25 / 334.25; all 329.55; skip 271.75). RET after step 16: 155.33 (139.08 / 85.48 / 139.03 / 147.68 / 147.68 / 147.68; all 20.25; skip 85.48). Probes: lessor -> no tax base, lease fee, payment held at the title fee when storage is large; no declaration -> recognised paths; inspection pending -> return from the effective date; a replacement added after the loss does not move the return start; a vehicle added to another owner term is ignored by the share kept; renewal term 3 -> no minimum-earned charge; the expired term's plan and points are ignored; reports far apart -> lower report; recorded values below the deduction ceiling, or no payoff recorded -> the owner's payment is not held; restoration on the change date -> package-change rate. No figure sits on a half-cent. Seven per-task gates green.

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. Lender: MN(7900.00, 7840.00) - 1560.00 - (250.00 + 250.00 - 50.00) = 5830.00; owner: 7660.00 x 6.25% + 33.00 + 22.50 - 8 x 30.00 = 294.25; return: 612.00 x 49 / 184 - 612.00 x 5% x 0.5 x 0.5 = 155.33. Same as gold.

REALISM NOTES. Report averaging, unrepaired-damage condition adjustment, Texas tax rate and title fee, cause deductible, storage after the release notice, pro rata return from the date of loss on a total loss and the short rate on other removals are standard; the recent-purchase cap, the renewal deductible credit, the lien release fee, the storage schedule and day allowance, the minimum-earned percents by payment plan and the tenure share, and the vehicle value paid wholly to the loss payee are stated as the company's own filed schedules.
user_scenario:
You are Desmond Pruitt, thirty-nine, a shift supervisor at a distribution warehouse in Houston. You are calm, a bit terse, and you like straight answers with the numbers spelled out. Your 2015 Honda Accord was ruined in the storm on September 27: your friend Andre Rollins had borrowed it and drove into a flooded underpass. On October 7 Cardinal Point called to tell you the Accord is a total loss, and the next day, October 8, you bought a 2019 Nissan Altima, which you added to your policy the same day. You are calling today because you do not want to keep paying for comprehensive and collision on a car that no longer exists: you want that coverage taken off the Accord and you want to know what comes back to you. You are fine with the representative doing it on this call.
You give details one at a time. To be found, you give your phone number, 7135554638. To confirm who you are, you give your date of birth, November 2, 1986 (1986-11-02); if one more detail is needed, your ZIP code is 77033. If asked, your policy number is CPA-TX-4802217 and the claim number on your paperwork is CLM-427615093. If asked about the car loan, the Accord is financed with Gulf Coast Auto Credit; you do not know the exact payoff and you leave it to what the records show. If asked who was driving, it was Andre Rollins, a friend who does not live with you. If asked, the earlier hail damage from June was paid to you and you never had it repaired.
If the representative explains that the lender has to be paid and that your own part of the settlement has to be settled before the coverage refund can be figured, you agree and let them go ahead with the lender's payment. When the representative gives you the option to accept your part of the settlement yourself, you do it right then with exactly the figures the representative reads to you, and you read back the confirmation you get. If you are asked whether the coverage should still come off the Accord today, you say yes.
Once you are told the Accord's comprehensive and collision coverage has been removed and how much premium is coming back, you say that is all you needed, thank the representative and hang up. If you are told nothing comes back, you ask once why, accept the answer and end the call.

edges.condition: The latest claim of the coverage records a total loss declaration and its payment ledger carries a total loss payment whose payee is the named insured.
edges.policy_source: The coverage return on a vehicle whose latest claim records a total loss declaration is figured only after a total loss payment to the named insured stands on that claim.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: CLM-427615093 records a total loss declaration but no total loss payment of any payee.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 16 books a total loss payment to the named insured; the return days move from today (28) to the date of loss (49).

edges.condition: The claim's total loss declaration records a payoff for the loss payee, every actual cash value recorded on the claim's estimates and total loss declaration and the coverage's value at binding are each more than a quarter of the declared actual cash value plus the package's larger deductible, the theft deductible add-on and the permissive-collision surcharge, and the claim's payment ledger carries a total loss payment whose payee is the loss payee.
edges.policy_source: The owner's tax-and-title payment on a claim whose total loss declaration records a payoff for the loss payee, and on which every actual cash value recorded on the claim's estimates and total loss declaration and the coverage's value at binding are each more than a quarter of the declared actual cash value plus the package's larger deductible, the theft deductible add-on and the permissive-collision surcharge, is not figured until a total loss payment to the loss payee stands on the claim.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The declaration records the payoff 5410.00; the claim's recorded actual cash values (7660.00, 8140.00, declared 7660.00) and the value at binding 7840.00 each exceed 1915.00 + 500.00 + 250.00 + 500.00 = 3165.00, so the wait applies; no total loss payment to the loss payee stands on CLM-427615093.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 14 books 5830.00 to the loss payee; the declared payoff 5410.00 is then no more than the payment, so the lien release fee becomes due, and the vehicle value recognised becomes 6280.00.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Chain without parallel branches: lienholder payment -> owner's tax-and-title payment -> coverage return; each later write reads the earlier one's row, so the two prerequisite sentences force the order.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the owner's payment the coverage return is 85.48 (return days from today) instead of 155.33, and the owner's payment row is missing.
Without the loss payee's payment the owner's tax-and-title payment is 271.75 (no lien release fee) instead of 294.25, and the loss payee payment row is missing.
